title: Restaurant entrance wordmark
slide_intent: Identify a destination at architectural scale so people can connect a place to previous brand encounters.
strategic_value: The white wordmark above the doorway can make Sweetgreen recognizable within a material-rich storefront.
demonstration: A white sweetgreen sign sits above a glass entrance framed by vertical timber slats, with a large palm leaf at right.
practical_value: Evaluate signature placement relative to doorway, façade texture and nearby vegetation.

content_islands.name: Entrance and sign
content_islands.spec: Place the wordmark above the glass doors within the vertical timber façade.

content_islands.name: Foreground plant
content_islands.spec: Retain the palm leaf that overlaps the right side of the scene.

reference_purposes.Application: The wordmark is installed above a restaurant entrance.
